I swapped Triceps Pushdown for Low-to-High Cable Fly in today's workout only. The fly puts much less stress on the elbow, and your routine is unchanged. 💪 Keep the load light and the elbow slightly bent. Since it's already bugging you, the presses may bother it too, so drop the weight on them. If you get sharp pain, or it lingers, stop and get it checked by a professional. ⚠️
